A single small plot of tilled farm soil holding one ripe carrot, a game asset for a mobile farming app. Only the parts of the carrot above the soil are visible: its orange shoulder peeking out and its feathery leaves. Nothing underground is shown: the soil is solid, with no cross-section, no cut-away and no glass. Strict isometric view: orthographic projection with no perspective, camera turned 45 degrees and tilted about 35 degrees down, so parallel edges stay parallel. Soft morning sunlight from the upper left. The plot is centered with generous empty margin around it. No text, no people, no ground plane. Plain flat dark charcoal background (#16171A).

The plot is a square tile of tilled soil with neat furrows, sitting on a chunky slab about a third as tall as it is wide: a thin grass rim on top and solid earthy sides. The carrot grows in the middle furrow.

Style: cel-shaded toon 3D. Clean simple shapes with two or three flat shading bands, crisp dark ink outlines around every shape, bright saturated colours, no textures. Like a cel-shaded adventure game.
